summary: Temporary restricted area for drones near Llanelli, Carmarthenshire, within 1 nautical mile, up to 1,400 feet.
text:
RESTRICTED AREA (TEMPORARY) INSTALLED FOR UAS ONLY (LLANELLI,
CARMARTHENSHIRE) WI 1NM RADIUS OF 514054N 0040950W. DOES NOT APPLY 
TO ANY UAS FLYING IN ACCORDANCE WITH EXCEPTIONS STATED IN THE 
BRIEFING SHEET BFS 130/2026 WITH CHART REFERS. FURTHER DETAILS 
WWW.NATS.AERO/AIS. RESTRICTION OF FLYING REGULATIONS MADE UNDER 
ARTICLE 239 OF AIR NAV ORDER 2016. AR-2026-9234/01.
